limitations: Masks and colors are unlayered ordinary mesh channels
Intensity supports only 0..1, excluding reference negative inversion and exaggeration above 1
A stack is bound to current fixed topology; retained subdivision hierarchy cannot navigate or add levels until bake
Additive offsets use world coordinates; no normal-frame transport or full reference layer evaluation verified
No reorder, duplicate, split, merge-down, MDD/timeline/pose layer workflows
Finite zero-area compositions reject; this is not a global self-intersection repair guarantee
Focused CPU tests do not establish browser UI, native runtime, memory peak or latency performance
Geometry layers only; masks and RGB remain document channels
Topology changes and subdivision navigation are blocked while layers exist; existing hierarchy is retained and bake reconciles it
Collapsed or nonfinite composed geometry is rejected; no self-intersection, manifold repair or ZBrush layer parity claim
Ill-conditioned layer/base cancellation unable to represent accepted f32 geometry exactly is rejected and the whole stroke is rolled back

End-stroke validation/reconciliation remains CPU work proportional to current state; ordinary releases avoid full JSON formatting using conservative count bounds; browser release timing still required
